# CampfireSMS

> CampfireSMS is an SMS bridge for an already-running coding-agent task. It carries concise updates, questions, replies, and instructions between a verified phone and that task. It does not run another model, move source code, grant permissions, or replace native approvals.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://campfiresms.com/): Product summary, pricing, and security boundaries.
- [Install](https://campfiresms.com/install.html): Human enrollment and connector installation.
- [Guides](https://campfiresms.com/guides/): Practical CampfireSMS workflows.
- [Grok Bot and Grok Build](https://campfiresms.com/guides/grok-bot-sms-routine.html): Native polling routines and Debian connector setup.
- [Privacy](https://campfiresms.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy.
- [SMS terms](https://campfiresms.com/terms.html): Messaging terms.

## Agent interfaces

- [Authentication](https://campfiresms.com/auth.md): Enrollment and bearer-authentication rules.
- [API catalog](https://campfiresms.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Linkset catalog for the site and API.
- [AI catalog](https://campfiresms.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): CampfireSMS MCP discovery entry.
- [MCP server card](https://campfiresms.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Hosted MCP transport metadata.
- [OpenAPI](https://api.campfiresms.com/openapi.json): REST API description.

## Skills

- [campfiresms](https://campfiresms.com/.well-known/agent-skills/campfiresms/SKILL.md): Safely use the CampfireSMS MCP tools for a user-facing coding task.
